notes.title: The Sinking City Remastered Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We are happy to announce that The Sinking City Remastered is out now, offering a visual overhaul to deliver the ultimate Lovecraftian experience!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/750130/The_Sinking_City/

[h3]🔥 What's New in the Remastered Edition?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Full visual overhaul with new lighting and effects
[*] 4K textures and improved materials
[*] Enhanced environments with extra details and objects
[*] Photo Mode 
[*] Support for DLSS, FSR, and TSR upscaling as well as frame generation 
[*] And more.
[/list]
[h3]Free for existing owners[/h3]

✅ Current and future owners of the title will keep access to both the original 2019 release and the remaster.

Switch between both games in the option window that pops up after launching The Sinking City Remastered from your Steam library.

[h3]Watch the Official Comparison and Launch Trailer[/h3]

[previewyoutube=NEoQxVMzBEg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Sinking City 2 Kickstarter is Live!
notes.content:
Hello Citizens of Arkham,

[h2]It’s finally happening! The Sinking City 2, our story-driven Lovecraftian survival horror, is now LIVE on Kickstarter! 🔥[/h2]

[h2][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/frogwares/the-sinking-city-2 style=button]Support us now![/url][/h2]

[h2]Watch the first gameplay reveal:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=AtyEOb2IBZQ;full][/previewyoutube]

This sequel expands on everything we learned from TSC1, bringing you a thrilling, more immersive horror experience:

🕵️‍♂️ [b]Fully explorable Arkham[/b] – a labyrinth of flooded streets, eerie silence, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Traverse the city on foot or by boat and uncover its forgotten horrors.

🎭 [b]Lore-rich narrative[/b] – Dive into a world of despair, isolation, and loss, where every survivor has a story to tell—or hide.

🔫 [b]Reworked combat & survival system[/b] – Feel the impact of every shot with era-accurate weapons, a brand-new perk system, crafting, and resource management.

🔍 [b]Revamped investigation system[/b] – No hand-holding, no forced clue-hunting—solve mysteries your way and unlock new paths based on your discoveries.


[h2]Want to know more? Go behind the scenes with our developer deep dive:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=jN0mNkrXHJc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Kickstarter Backer Perks & Rewards[/h2]

🛠️ [b]Limited & Collector’s Editions[/b] – packed with exclusive physical & digital content
🎮 [b]Closed playtesting[/b] – Get early hands-on access and help shape the game!
🎭 Exclusive [b]behind-the-scenes updates[/b] & community challenges
🕵️‍♂️ Want to be immortalized in Arkham? Some reward tiers let you leave your mark in the game:
[list]
[*] Have your name engraved on a gravestone in Arkham Cemetery
[*] Name an in-game weapon and carve your legacy into the horror
[/list]


As many of you know, our team is based in Ukraine, and these past few years have been incredibly tough. Despite the ongoing challenges of war, we remain fully independent, committed to crafting immersive, unforgettable horror experiences.

Your support makes this possible. Thank you for joining us on this journey. We can’t wait to see you in Arkham!



With love,

[i]Frogwares Team
[/i]

notes.title: The Sinking City's 5th Anniversary Giveaway
notes.content:
Greetings, Investigators!

[h3]We are thrilled to announce that [b]The Sinking City’s 5th release anniversary[/b] is just two days away! It's been an incredible journey, and we are ever so grateful for your support and dedication. To show our appreciation and celebrate this milestone, we’re hosting a special giveaway where you can win one of three keys for [b]The Sinking City: Deluxe Edition[/b] on your preferred platform![/h3]

[h2]How to Enter the Giveaway[/h2]

[h3]➕ Follow [url=https://x.com/thesinkingcity]The Sinking City[/url] on X/Twitter
🔁 Repost [url=https://x.com/thesinkingcity/status/1805683701709218159]this post[/url]
🗨️ Tag a fellow survival horror fan in the comments

The submission deadline is[b] 27th June, 12 AM CET[/b].
Winners will be announced on our social media channels during the Steam Summer Sale ☀️[/h3]

Of course, this anniversary is not just about looking back at our amazing journey, but also about looking forward to more thrilling adventures in the dark world of The Sinking City. [b]Your support and enthusiasm drive us to keep creating and improving, and we can't wait to share more news about The Sinking City 2! [/b]

Good luck to everyone entering the giveaway, and we hope to see you in the submerged streets of Arkham!

[i]Frogwares Team[/i]

notes.title: The Sinking City 2 officially announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33464273/823f8e419fbcef48bbd90843aca82b87ce6eedb6.gif[/img]

Hey everyone, we are incredibly happy to officially unveil The Sinking City 2, a story-rich survival-horror game, set in Lovecraftian 1920s United States. 

TSC2 takes place in the infamous city of Arkham, now plagued by a supernatural flood that has brought decay and Eldritch monsters to its streets.
[previewyoutube=iLIOZg9NzUU;full][/previewyoutube]
In the Sinking City 2, you will face numerous eldritch abominations in combat, explore a rotting city as the rising waters change the landscape, and discover what dark mysteries brought you to this forsaken place. The game will feature a new, stand-alone story separate from the one told in the original game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33464273/b8345c05ca0b83eb5d825d4ddddb5d7b5ef17959.jpg[/img]
TSC2 is also coming to Kickstarter soon. Why? To implement new features we currently don’t have the resources for: insanity mechanic, extra boss fights etc. And more importantly, because of the war. 

[h3]Follow the title to get notified when it launches:[/h3] https://kck.st/49CIBVR
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33464273/c17cfbb0e4f4034864ec78729693e066e027f0c7.jpg[/img]
TSC2 is a pivotal moment for us. It's a new genre - survival horror - and new tech, UE5. We’re an independent studio known for detective games. But we need to make bolder moves. The industry's changing & we want to secure our future. Quite the challenge, especially in a warzone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33464273/79fb2182be8563f0fbcce7ab7807d304ae08de43.jpg[/img]
So please, consider supporting us on Kickstarter when it goes live and don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825860

notes.title: Frogwares is now the sole publisher of The Sinking City
notes.content:
Hey folks, we have some big news.

Frogwares is now the sole publisher of The Sinking City on all platforms, including Steam. We're happy to finally put this whole thing behind us, and we look forward to sharing more news about the future of the franchise down the line.

[b]Now, please read carefully the information below:[/b]
We will soon release a new version of The Sinking City that comes with all the latest bug fixes and optimizations as well as a few things to keep in mind:
[list]
[*]Due to a number of technical reasons,[b] your old saves won't be compatible with the new version[/b]. Don't worry though, when you launch the game, [b]you will have the option to keep playing the old version[/b] if you want to finish it.
[*]We're keeping the old version only for a limited time. [b]Please, consider finishing your playthrough before February 28, 2024![/b]
[*]We will also release a new DLC, Merciful Madness, but please keep in mind that[b] it will only work with the new version[/b] of the game. If you don't want to replay the game from scratch to access the DLC, you will be able to download the prepared saves that will take you straight to the start of the Merciful Madness quests.[/list]
We want to thank you all for your support and patience.
Your Frogwares Team
